own_solution.law: Envelope A = A0 exp(-b t/(2m)); t = (2m/b) ln(1/f)

notes: Verified: base 8.04719 s; extra damper 0.15 -> b = 0.35, t = 1.609438/0.35 = 4.59839 s; 0.19 -> 4.12676 s; 0.29 -> b = 0.49, t = 3.28457 s. Spring constants 30, 60, 110 N/m all keep the motion strongly underdamped (2 sqrt(km) >= 7.75 kg/s vs b <= 0.49 kg/s), and the envelope decay rate b/(2m) is independent of k, so the C claim holds; the energy-based cancellation relation (k cancels in the energy ratio) is valid. Minimal pairs T66F6/T2CC3 and TFF7E/TDAF8 share 0.19 kg/s and differ only in attachment/timing; numeral-free twins T7E76 and TB3BF match their twins except 'a small value'. Agrees with pass 1.
